text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trainer from my cohort was leaving the 
academy. I was put in charge of organizing 
the farewell party, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Balancing daily training sessions with my 
trainee while handling all the planning 
for the farewell party proved far more 
exhausting than I had anticipated.
choice_data_list:
...All that's left is reserving the 
flowers for the party.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing my tired body to keep moving, I 
made my way to the flower shop, where a 
lone student stood quietly.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ! U-Um— Are you... alright?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You seem unsteady on your feet— and your 
complexion does not look well either...
choice_data_list:
...I've just been swamped organizing an 
event.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So that is why you look so worn out... It 
must be terribly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Um, if it is choosing flowers, I believe 
I might be able to help. If it pleases 
you—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—There, the reservation is complete. A 
bouquet of gerberas wishing for hope and 
forward steps... I am certain it will 
bring them great joy on that day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to say "thank you," a 
yawn nearly escaped my lips, and I hastily 
covered my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—You truly do seem exhausted... Are you 
not pushing yourself far too hard—?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The organizer duties—could someone else 
perhaps take over for you?

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to take the lead, I really 
would... but my trainee's entire future is 
riding on this next race.

text_block_list.name: Peer Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Mine is gearing up for their debut race 
too, so I just don't have the bandwidth to 
organize it... I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone genuinely wished to celebrate 
their colleague's departure, but at the 
same time, they were devoted to their 
trainees' futures. It was hard for anyone 
to step up. In that case—
choice_data_list:
...I'll handle it! I've still got more 
leeway than everyone else.

...I'll handle it! I've still got more 
leeway than everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I see—you hold such kind consideration for 
so many people. ...However—
choice_data_list: Guess I'm just not capable enough, huh...
Guess I'm just not capable enough, huh...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —No. That is by no means the case.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Handling your everyday responsibilities 
alongside organizing an entire event— that 
would be grueling for anyone...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If so—humble though my efforts may be, if 
I might help lessen your burden in any 
way...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Please— allow me to assist you further...!

text_block_list.name: Café Manager
text_block_list.text:
—A farewell party for your colleague? 
Sounds great! As long as you book in 
advance, we can even reserve the entire 
floor for you.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—. Um... could we take a look at the 
menu—?
choice_data_list:
Do you have seafood? It's my colleague's 
favorite.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, it seems they offer course 
menus. Both of them—look wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Café Manager
text_block_list.text:
Those are our house specialties! If you 
look around the shop, you'll spot 
ocean-themed decor too. This ship in a 
bottle looks pretty nice, doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
It's lovely! It fits my colleague's tastes 
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—To suit your colleague's tastes. Um, in 
that case—Trainer-san? The farewell 
gift—could it be—
choice_data_list:
That's it! Excuse me, manager, where did 
you get this?

text_block_list.name: Café Manager
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm thrilled you like it! It's from a 
friend's shop nearby. Here, let me show 
you the map!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Karen Bouquetd'or's thoughtful 
and devoted assistance after that, the 
preparations were completed in no time at 
all.
choice_data_list:
Incredible... It's all thanks to your 
help!

Incredible... It's all thanks to your 
help!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If—I was truly able to be of help, then I 
am genuinely glad.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone as kind as you— overworking 
yourself so terribly, it pained my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Acting for the happiness of everyone— is 
indeed a noble virtue.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
However—if anything were to happen to 
you... those who cherish you— and I, too, 
would be heartbroken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words struck me with sudden 
realization. If I hadn't received her 
help, and had collapsed from exhaustion 
instead—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... please. Whenever you are 
troubled—rely on others.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
For in everyone's happiness— your own 
happiness must also be included—after all.
choice_data_list:
...I understand. Thank you for telling me 
that.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The farewell party—was a great success, 
then. —I am so glad.
choice_data_list:
Thanks to you, we gave them a wonderful 
send-off.
Sorry for making you worry back then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I had tried to shoulder everything 
alone, I surely wouldn't have been able to 
put together such a satisfying farewell 
party.
choice_data_list:
Things really do go better when you don't 
carry it all alone.

Things really do go better when you don't 
carry it all alone.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. Joining hands and maintaining 
harmony— that is the secret to happiness.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, please— I did nothing so grand.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—More than that. Seeing you smiling now— 
brings me such joy.
